name: Plugin Card
description: Draggable/resizable card widget for housing plugins on the canvas. Created with a unique UUID via crypto.randomUUID(). Card structure: header with canvas-rendered title (via @chenglou/pretext for measurement and layout), minimize/fit-viewport/terminate buttons, body div, and edge resize handles (east, south, southeast). Drag snaps to 28px grid. Resize with minimum 280px (10*SNAP). Mousedown delegation to callbacks on options. Double-click header triggers fitViewport. Context menu on header right-click.

dependencies.usage: Canvas text rendering for card body content via setContent()

interface.constructor: constructor(parent: HTMLElement, opts: CardOptions, getTransform: () => { scale: number; panX: number; panY: number })

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the card title onto the header canvas using @chenglou/pretext for multi-line layout with device pixel ratio scaling.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets card body content by rendering text to a canvas via TextRenderer.createCanvas().

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Calls onDestroy callback and removes the card DOM element.

properties.name: el
properties.description: Root DOM element of the card with class 'card'.

properties.name: opts
properties.description: Configuration options passed at construction including callbacks and dimensions.

properties.name: onDestroy
properties.description: External destroy callback, fired on remove().

events.name: onDragStart
events.description: Fired when card header mousedown triggers drag start.

events.name: onDragMove
events.description: Fired during card drag on mousemove.

events.name: onDragEnd
events.description: Fired on mouseup after drag, with final world coordinates.

events.name: onResizeEnd
events.description: Fired after resize mouseup with final width and height.

events.name: onFocus
events.description: Fired on mousedown anywhere on the card (capture phase).

events.name: onHeaderContextMenu
events.description: Fired on right-click of card header.

events.name: onFitViewport
events.description: Fired on fit-viewport button click or header double-click.
